summary_en: 4,000,000 shares to be cancelled, representing 0.4% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Cancellation scheduled for 2026-07-31. Conditional on completion of ongoing public tender offer for treasury stock acquisition. Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding expected to total 949,183,028.

summary_en: Self-tender offer price set at ¥3,401/share (10% discount to lower of 1-month VWAP ¥4,848 and May 20 closing price ¥3,779). Offer launches May 21, 2026. Acquisition cap and share count not disclosed. Partial cancellation of acquired shares under consideration.
summary_jp: 公開買付価格を1ヶ月平均値と当日終値の低い方に10%割引した¥3,401/株に決定。5月21日開始。買付上限額・株数未開示。取得した普通株式の一部消却を検討中。
